  "source": [
    "function scpr_authority_check.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(TASK) TYPE  SCPRAUTH",
    "*\"     VALUE(ID) TYPE  SCPR_ID OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     VALUE(CATEGORY) TYPE  SCPR_CTGRY OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      WRONG_PARAMETERS",
    "*\"      NO_AUTHORITY",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "  data: l_create_possible type sy-subrc value 0,",
    "        l_change_possible type sy-subrc value 0.",
    "  data  wa_scprsreca  type scprsreca.",
    "",
    "",
    "  sy-subrc = 0.",
    "  case task.",
    "",
    "* Berechtigung zum Aktivieren von BC-Sets",
    "    when 'ACTIVATE'.",
    "      authority-check object 'S_TCODE'",
    "         id 'TCD' field 'SCPR20'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e247 with sy-uname sy-sysid sy-mandt",
    "                                       raising no_authority.",
    "      else.",
    "        if not scpr_authority_check is initial.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                id 'ACTVT' field '07'.",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            message e247 with sy-uname sy-sysid sy-mandt",
    "                                        raising no_authority.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "",
    "* Berechtigung zum ungeprüften Aktivieren von BC-Sets",
    "    when 'ACTUNCHKT'.",
    "      authority-check object 'S_TCODE'",
    "         id 'TCD' field 'SCPR20'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e379 with sy-uname sy-sysid sy-mandt",
    "                                        raising no_authority.",
    "      else.",
    "        if not scpr_authority_check is initial.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                               id 'ACTVT' field '63'.",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            message e379 with sy-uname sy-sysid sy-mandt",
    "                                        raising no_authority.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "",
    "* Berechtigung zum Bearbeiten von BC-Sets",
    "    when 'CHANGE'.",
    "      authority-check object 'S_TCODE'",
    "         id 'TCD' field 'SCPR3'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e179 raising no_authority.",
    "      else.",
    "        if not scpr_authority_check is initial.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                id 'ACTVT' field '02'.",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            message e179 raising no_authority.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "",
    "* Berechtigung zum Bearbeiten von BC-Sets",
    "    when 'CHANGE+ID'.",
    "*     Im Gegensatz zum 'CHANGE' wird hier auch geprüft, ob sich",
    "*     ein BC-Set noch im Anlegeprozess befindet, d.h. es wurde",
    "*     über eine automatische Customizingaufzeichnung neu angelegt",
    "*     (enthält nur \"unvollständige\" Datensätze) und soll z.B.",
    "*     in der SCPR3 vervollständigt werden.",
    "      authority-check object 'S_TCODE'",
    "         id 'TCD' field 'SCPR3'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e179 raising no_authority.",
    "      else.",
    "        if not scpr_authority_check is initial.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                id 'ACTVT' field '02'. \"CHANGE",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "*           CHANGE verbieten ausser das BC-Set befindet sich im",
    "*           \"Anlegeprozess\" und Anlegen ist erlaubt",
    "            l_change_possible = sy-subrc.",
    "            if not id is initial.",
    "              authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                    id 'ACTVT' field '01'. \"CREATE",
    "              if sy-subrc = 0.",
    "                if category = pcat_switch.",
    "                  select single * from scprsreca into wa_scprsreca",
    "                         where id         = id",
    "                           and version    = 'N'",
    "                           and uncomplete = ' '. \"<> 'U'",
    "                  if sy-subrc = 0.",
    "*                 Das BC-Set enthält zumindest einen Datensatz, der",
    "*                 bereits vervollständigt ist - somit ist das BC-Set",
    "*                 nicht als \"neu\" zubetrachten bzw. es befindet sich",
    "*                 nicht mehr im Anlegeprozess. -> CHANGE nicht erlauben",
    "                    l_change_possible = 1.",
    "                  else.",
    "*                 Ansonsten prüfen, ob es überhaupt einen Datensatz im",
    "*                 BC-Set gibt",
    "                    select single * from scprsreca into wa_scprsreca",
    "                           where id = id and version = 'N'.",
    "                    if sy-subrc = 0.",
    "*                   CHANGE erlauben",
    "                      l_change_possible = 0.",
    "                    else.",
    "*                   CHANGE nicht erlauben",
    "                      l_change_possible = 1.",
    "                    endif.",
    "                  endif.",
    "                else.",
    "                  select single * from scprreca",
    "                         where id         = id",
    "                           and version    = 'N'",
    "                           and uncomplete = ' '. \"<> 'U'",
    "                  if sy-subrc = 0.",
    "*                 Das BC-Set enthält zumindest einen Datensatz, der",
    "*                 bereits vervollständigt ist - somit ist das BC-Set",
    "*                 nicht als \"neu\" zubetrachten bzw. es befindet sich",
    "*                 nicht mehr im Anlegeprozess. -> CHANGE nicht erlauben",
    "                    l_change_possible = 1.",
    "                  else.",
    "*                 Ansonsten prüfen, ob es überhaupt einen Datensatz im",
    "*                 BC-Set gibt",
    "                    select single * from scprreca",
    "                           where id = id and version = 'N'.",
    "                    if sy-subrc = 0.",
    "*                   CHANGE erlauben",
    "                      l_change_possible = 0.",
    "                    else.",
    "*                   CHANGE nicht erlauben",
    "                      l_change_possible = 1.",
    "                    endif.",
    "                  endif.",
    "                endif.",
    "              endif.",
    "            endif.",
    "          else.",
    "*           CHANGE erlauben",
    "            l_change_possible = 0.",
    "          endif.",
    "          if l_change_possible <> 0.",
    "            message e179 raising no_authority.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "",
    "* Berechtigung zum Überschreiben von Fixwerten",
    "    when 'CHGFIXVAL'.",
    "      authority-check object 'S_TCODE'",
    "         id 'TCD' field 'SCPR20'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e381 raising no_authority.",
    "      else.",
    "        if not scpr_authority_check is initial.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                 id 'ACTVT' field '95'.",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            message e381 raising no_authority.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "",
    "* Berechtigung zum Anlegen von BC-Sets",
    "    when 'CREATE'.",
    "      authority-check object 'S_TCODE'",
    "         id 'TCD' field 'SCPR3'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e246 raising no_authority.",
    "      else.",
    "        if not scpr_authority_check is initial.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                 id 'ACTVT' field '01'.",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            message e246 raising no_authority.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "",
    "* Kombinierte Berechtigungsprüfung: Anlegen ODER Ändern von BC-Sets",
    "    when 'CREA_OR_CHNG'.",
    "      authority-check object 'S_TCODE'",
    "         id 'TCD' field 'SCPR3'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e179 raising no_authority.",
    "      else.",
    "        if not scpr_authority_check is initial.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                id 'ACTVT' field '02'. \"CHANGE",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            l_change_possible = sy-subrc.",
    "          endif.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                id 'ACTVT' field '01'. \"CREATE",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            l_create_possible = sy-subrc.",
    "          endif.",
    "          if l_change_possible <> 0 and l_create_possible <> 0.",
    "            message e179 raising no_authority.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "",
    "* Kombinierte Berechtigungsprüfung: Anlegen UND Ändern von BC-Sets",
    "    when 'CREA_AND_CHNG'.",
    "      authority-check object 'S_TCODE'",
    "         id 'TCD' field 'SCPR3'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e179 raising no_authority.",
    "      else.",
    "        if not scpr_authority_check is initial.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                id 'ACTVT' field '02'. \"CHANGE",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            l_change_possible = sy-subrc.",
    "          endif.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                id 'ACTVT' field '01'. \"CREATE",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            l_create_possible = sy-subrc.",
    "          endif.",
    "          if l_change_possible <> 0 or l_create_possible <> 0.",
    "            message e179 raising no_authority.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "* authority checks for the Switch BC Set recording",
    "    when 'RECORD_COMPL'.",
    "      authority-check object 'S_TCODE'",
    "         id 'TCD' field 'SCPR3'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e179 raising no_authority.",
    "      else.",
    "        if not scpr_authority_check is initial.",
    "* recording into existing Switch BC Set -> change Switch BC Set",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                id 'ACTVT' field '82'.",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            message e179 raising no_authority.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "* Berechtigung zum Löschen von BC-Sets",
    "    when 'DELETE'.",
    "      authority-check object 'S_TCODE'",
    "         id 'TCD' field 'SCPR3'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e309 raising no_authority.",
    "      else.",
    "        if not scpr_authority_check is initial.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                               id 'ACTVT' field '06'.",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            message e309 raising no_authority.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "",
    "* Berechtigung zum Anzeigen von BC-Sets",
    "    when 'DISPLAY'.",
    "      authority-check object 'S_TCODE'",
    "         id 'TCD' field 'SCPR3'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e331 raising no_authority.",
    "      else.",
    "        if not scpr_authority_check is initial.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                id 'ACTVT' field '03'.",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            message e331 raising no_authority.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "",
    "* Berechtigung zum Erweitern von BC-Set Dokumentation",
    "    when 'DOKUADD'.",
    "      authority-check object 'S_TCODE'",
    "         id 'TCD' field 'SCPR3'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e380 raising no_authority.",
    "      else.",
    "        if not scpr_authority_check is initial.",
    "          authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                                id 'ACTVT' field '23'.",
    "          if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "            message e380 raising no_authority.",
    "          endif.",
    "        endif.",
    "      endif.",
    "",
    "* Berechtigung zum ändern der Systemeinstellungen -> werden",
    "* immer geprüft, auch wenn die BC-Set Berechtigungsprüfung",
    "* nicht explizit aktiviert wurde",
    "    when 'SYSSET'.",
    "      authority-check object scpr_authority_object",
    "                             id 'ACTVT' field '70'.",
    "      if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        message e479 raising no_authority.",
    "      endif.",
    "",
    "* ungültige Parameter beim FB-Aufruf",
    "    when others.",
    "      message e273 raising wrong_parameters.",
    "  endcase.",
    "",
    "",
    "endfunction."
  ],

}
